about: A database tool for browsing, querying and exporting data from many kinds of databases.

prs.title: Negative numbers export as numbers, not text
prs.broken: Exports put an apostrophe in front of every negative number, so spreadsheets showed it and treated the cells as text that could not be added up.
prs.changed: I made the export leave plain numbers alone while still guarding real formulas.
prs.matters: Exported CSV and Excel files open with working numbers.
